deposit-file.name: Deposit File
deposit-file.description: Pull ledger lines and index move-in/out photos. Proposed charges only — not a refund.

late-rent-list.name: Late Rent List
late-rent-list.description: Balances from the roll they name. No pay-or-quit text or lockout language.

make-ready-pack.name: Make Ready Pack
make-ready-pack.description: Punch for one vacant unit they name. Rent-ready is their label, not an inspection pass.

notice-process.name: Notice Process
notice-process.description: Log notices they already use. Do not draft statutory pay-or-quit or eviction text.

owner-month.name: Owner Month
owner-month.description: Period files for one property and named date range. Do not send owner money.

rent-roll-pack.name: Rent Roll Pack
rent-roll-pack.description: Export the roll as-of the date they name. Snapshot plus questions, not a legal lease.

showing-week.name: Showing Week
showing-week.description: Week's tours from their calendar. No steering copy and no lockbox codes.

unit-turnover.name: Unit Turnover
unit-turnover.description: Vacate file, make-ready punch, and rent-ready label. Not an inspection certificate.

vendor-quotes.name: Vendor Quotes
vendor-quotes.description: Quote PDFs for one work order. They pick and they approve.

work-orders.name: Work Orders
work-orders.description: Live work-order export plus flags. They dispatch and they pay vendors.
